headline: One Van Gogh is never enough! So how many Sunflowers did he paint? Find out in our great British museum quiz
context: What’s Britain’s best museum? We asked the five shortlisted for the Art Fund’s £120,000 prize to pose questions about their collections. Here, National Gallery curators get the ball rolling … so do you know the story of their cut-up Manet? Continue reading...
